title: Group
description: A Microsoft Entra security group or Microsoft 365 group managed via Microsoft Graph

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the group object (UUID, read-only)

fields.name: mailNickname
fields.description: Mail alias without the domain suffix

fields.name: securityEnabled
fields.description: Whether the group is a security group

fields.name: groupTypes
fields.description: Group type flags: Unified = Microsoft 365 group, DynamicMembership = dynamic group

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: Visibility for Microsoft 365 groups: Public, Private, or HiddenMembership

fields.name: onPremisesSyncEnabled
fields.description: Whether synced from on-premises Active Directory

fields.name: renewedDateTime
fields.description: When the Microsoft 365 group was last renewed

fields.name: expirationDateTime
fields.description: When the group expires (if expiration policy is set)
